entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It's so good!
Glad we actually got one.
What a great Christmas.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Right? Maybe it was a good thing all[n]the restaurants turned us away.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Oh, right...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Here, before I forget. I got you a present.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I have to say, um... my life's gotten a lot[n]more unpredictable since I met you.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But we got through everything so far.[n]And it's made me realize... I wouldn't[n]want it any other way.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I thought you might like this watch.[n]Just in case we, ah... lose track of time[n]together.
Thanks.
I'll take good care of it.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It's really nothing fancy, but I'm glad[n]you like it.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Oh, wait. Don't move, [fName].
Makoto is staring at me...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You had some cream on your nose.[n]How'd that even get there?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...I usually don't laugh this much[n]on Christmas.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But I guess it's not just the holidays...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Meeting you's helped me see so much[n]humor, even excitement in the most[n]trivial things...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You helped me find so many new[n]experiences beyond the life I'd[n]known.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...Thank you.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: For spending Christmas with me.[n]And... for loving me.
I always will.
My pleasure.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...Oh, you.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Oh... look, [fName]!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It's so beautiful... The snow must have[n]picked up after we got back.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Coming back to Leblanc really was[n]the smart move. Now we get to[n]enjoy the view.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I didn't know I could be this happy.[n]It almost doesn't feel real...
It is, though.
It's all real.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You're right. It's just so different from[n]how things used to be...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hey, it's getting pretty bad out there.[n]This much snow is bound to stop[n]the train schedules.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hope you don't mind, but...[n]I'll be staying a little longer.
Makoto and I spent some[n]time alone together...
